title: Wren and the Compass
author: August Villalobos
blurb: Lior Iversen, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
